title: 1,700 UK Investors Sue Binance Over Derivatives Offerings

facts.claim: Approximately 1,700 UK investors are suing Binance and Changpeng Zhao for £150 million ($200 million) over unregulated derivatives offerings.
facts.subject: Binance
facts.cause: Binance offered leverage tokens, futures and options without regulatory approval after FCA banned such products in January 2021

facts.claim: Binance failed to secure Markets in Crypto-Assets-compliant license from an EU member state by the July 1, 2026 regulatory deadline.
facts.subject: Binance
facts.cause: EU regulatory requirement for crypto exchange operations

facts.claim: Binance faced allegations of facilitating $850 million in transactions tied to a sanctioned Iranian financier linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps.
facts.subject: Binance
facts.cause: Alleged facilitation of sanctioned transactions

title: France Reports 77 Crypto Wrench Attacks in 2026
